method: Each definition in s19-mutation-defs.json applied alone by exact text replacement, its whole test file run with the vitest JSON reporter, every touched file restored and compared by SHA-256, then the whole file rerun. A proof needs the named row to fail on an AssertionError, a byte-identical restore and an all-passing rerun; other failing rows are recorded. The integration test runs the real public route handlers, including POST /api/v1/purchase-requests with a FIXTURE agent token, as envoi_web on a local PostgreSQL database built from the migrations, with DATABASE_URL removed, holding the seeded demo FIXTURE shop with its FIXTURE PayPal sandbox seller and one confirmed but unpublished FIXTURE shop; PayPal is never called. The unit tests read the generated client's source and check the contract validator on the real document. Every definition here is an S19 test recorded in 00-status.md.
